scope: One static fixed-pool GPU staged feasibility/attribution prototype; no paper novelty,production dispatch or dynamic integration

candidate.name: P1_STAGED_COMPACT
candidate.state: 16-byte AoS:FP64 bounded estimate,int32 original row ID,uint32 current-stage ordered replay coordinates
candidate.selection: stable installed CUB DeviceSelect::Flagged at every boundary
candidate.owner_construction: Stage1 generates all IDs within each request; no setup survivors
candidate.numerics: NUMERICS.md outward intervals + exact ordered prefix fallback; retained full hits replay ordered960
candidate.fields: ascending complete occurrence IDs;FP32 sqrt fields plus charged FP64 cast of FP32 squared scores;original5e-5 scale tolerance;0 FN/FP against ordered oracle

pre_GPU_gate.admit: coordinate+owner+state<=1.25GB; also include tuple counter bytes/flags/replay bound in stricter screen

novelty.rule: early abandoning,dimension pruning/vertical layouts and compaction already established; bounded diagnostic only,no new-thesis admission

hardware.model: NVIDIA RTX PRO6000 Blackwell Server Edition
hardware.single_device: current empty same-model card chosen live;placement private
hardware.isolation: existing two-sided-starttime static_guard,shared per-device advisory locks plus one campaign flock;first foreign activity stops

qualification.checkpoints: every complete GPU checkpoint ID against Gate1 required_dims/full scores;all40 original queries
qualification.sanitizer_scope: synthetic plus bounded4096 target only;no full-N sanitizer claim

measurement.primary: Host request ready -> complete Host output ready
measurement.point_estimator: ratio of medians of6 process mean ACKs
measurement.paired: six matched-round P1/B1 geometric ratio;bootstrap20000 seed2026101302,process resampling,95% percentile CI

diagnostics.NCU: fresh independent B1/P1 processes;capture all32 measured queries and sum ALL stage/selection/materialization kernels per query,not just first/easy query;API ranges enabled in diagnostic-only host adapter
diagnostics.traffic_estimator: mean of32 all-kernel DRAM totals;also disclose per-query min/p90/max,full DRAM read/write/L2 and all kernel families
diagnostics.stage_events: one separate40-query P1 process with scan/selection/output events,host phase and count waits;not primary timings
diagnostics.NSYS: one diagnostic-only P1 trace if latency/CI misses GO;CUDA/NVTX without CPU sampling or settings changes;retain launch/copy gaps

gates.GO_PROGRESSIVE_GPU: all quality gates AND mean totalDRAM<=1.60e9 AND median-P1/median-B1<=.80 AND paired95%CIupper<.90
gates.STRONG_GO: GO plus DRAM<=1.30e9 AND ratio<=.65;label remains GO
gates.NO_GO_PROGRESSIVE_GPU: DRAM>2.20e9 OR (ratio>=1 AND no separately isolated>20% control component)
gates.BYTE_SAVING_BUT_CONTROL_BOUND: not earlier class AND DRAM<=1.60e9 AND ratio>.90
gates.UNCLASSIFIED: all other valid numerical intervals or missing quality/measurement evidence;stop,no auto tuning
gates.control_component: event/trace-isolated selection+launch/count/output component,not unexplained residual alone
gates.persistent_motivation: selection>=25% of complete ACK is evidence for future design only;no implementation this round
gates.human_clarification: 2026-10-13 approved GO first,NO_GO precedence over BYTE overlap,gray zones stop,no threshold relaxation

budget.retries: none automatic;retain failed/unexecuted entries and stop on first runtime/isolation/quality/provenance failure

publication: task-owned source,scalar tables,raw-log/report identities and plots only;vectors,full outputs,profiler binaries,placement and credentials stay private
